title: Request Access
intro_description: CUNY faculty, staff, and students can use this form to request access to CAIL services or ask for help with an existing account.
features: CAIL Sandbox with a curated set of AI models
Transcription and accessible image descriptions, plus document OCR
Agent Studio and Site Studio for research and publishing workflows
Personal API keys and usage information through Model Access
Support from the CUNY AI Lab team

individual.label: Individual
individual.description: Access or support for your own Lab account.

class.label: Class
class.description: Request access for a course or cohort. The Lab reviews the application before anyone is invited.

application_kind.class_note: A class application is separate from an individual Lab application. You do not need existing Lab access to apply for a class. Approved participants receive regular Lab access for the class dates.

campus.label: CUNY College/Campus
campus.placeholder: e.g., Graduate Center, Hunter College, Baruch

intended_use.label: Intended Use or Support Request
intended_use.placeholder: Describe how you plan to use CAIL services, or tell us what help you need.

ends_on.label: End Date
ends_on.help: The last day participants need access.

privacy_note: The Lab stores this information to review your request, manage access, and contact you about CAIL services.

next_steps.title: Review
next_steps.description: The Lab reviews the application and checks the information provided.

next_steps.title: Decision
next_steps.description: The Lab approves the request, declines it, or follows up for more information.

next_steps.title: Invitation
next_steps.description: After class approval, coordinators sign in with CUNY Login. Participants use the invitation to sign in and claim a spot.

next_steps.title: Access
next_steps.description_html: Individual applicants and approved class participants use the same regular Lab access through the Tools page. Class access follows the approved dates.

questions_text: Have questions about access or the platform?
questions_link_text: Contact the CUNY AI Lab Team →
